rationale: M0 is a C4X ladder on the declared-zero work qubits q4 and q5, and both enclosing pairs P0 and P1 are clean. That makes them direct temporary ANDs at 4 T each with measurement-based uncompute. The middle Toffoli T2 targets the data qubit q6, so it uses the Jones construction (4 T, one fresh ancilla), for a total of 12 T versus the 35 T naive cost.
